title: Nevada test fallout theory dismissed as baseless

tellings.quote: Yeah, some of the testing in Nevada could have

plain: One idea holds that fallout from weapons testing in Nevada explains the strange events on a ranch in Utah, and Brandon Fugal, the owner of that ranch, known as Skinwalker Ranch for its many odd reports, talks about it. He grants that "some of the testing in Nevada could have" played a part, but in the end he treats the theory as having no real basis, which would leave the ranch's events unexplained.
